manualBump.finalHit: remove only this deposit obstruction; next explicit movement into cleared cell uses ordinary terrain movement cost
manualBump.refusal: existing wrongTool,hiddenOrMissing,outOfReach,priorityInteraction,exhausted,stale or save refusal spends0 mining turns/materials/work and grants0 output; do not fall through to charged blocked movement
manualBump.priority: existing encounter/authored-interaction priorities retain ownership; mining cannot bypass them
manualBump.dispatch: only an actually blocking undepleted harvest source; exhausted footprint uses ordinary movement

automaticNavigation.passability: live blocking deposits excluded from traversal; route around or stop
automaticNavigation.depositDestination: route may end on explicitly selected reachable adjacent ground; deposit footprint is never a traversal step
automaticNavigation.arrival: never queue or perform mining automatically; fresh manual intent required
automaticNavigation.dynamicObstruction: stop/replan under existing navigation rules without mining or spending a mining turn

protectedRoutes: starter resources and their work positions
placement.forbidden: no sole reachable Iron behind an Iron-Pick requirement; no protected route needing an unavailable tool
placement.optionalAreas: deliberately fully tool-gated areas are later scope; this cutover permits detours and shortcuts, not new inaccessible districts
placement.budgets: unchanged shared mineral/source budgets; written and ordinary reservations use same placements

persistence.newSources: freeze deposit obstruction and physical source version at generation; preserve work through save/relaunch/anchor
persistence.legacy: old worlds and existing saved source collision retain old semantics; do not infer new blocking from a live producer-ID lookup on old saves
persistence.atomicity: yield,work,depletion,obstruction,turn and terminal events commit together; no open path or impact success before durable commit; retry cannot repeat output

presentation.canopy: deposits have no foliage crown; separate deposit obstruction from blockingTrunk/liveCrown
